title: CivicMAPS residential parking permit
description: A council-issued residential parking permit and its vehicle (owner direction 23/11/2026). The permit number is authoritative: prefix, issue year, sequential ID and amendment are derived from it (and checked when also given). Status shown to officers is only valid / expired: valid from 00:00 on validFrom until midnight at the end of validTo.

authority.description: Issuing council: the user-facing council code (e.g. com) and, once onboarded, the CivicMAPS linking ID. Areas are com-rpa7 user facing, <linkingId>-com-rpa7 operationally.

permitNumber.description: Permit types, issue year, four-digit sequential ID and optional amendment suffix. Types: RPA (residential parking area), RSP (residential street permit), RP (resident permit), FS (foreshore); a combination lists each type with COMB, e.g. RPA/COMB/FS.

prefix.description: Derived from permitNumber; must match when given.

validTo.description: Expires at midnight at the end of this date.

parkingAreaCode.description: Residential parking area code (required for RPA permits).

address.description: Registered address of the vehicle (RSP: its street segment; RP: directly in front of it).
